Cueverse Player Card Classification Chart

🛡️

Attribute Performance Metrics Glossary

Tactical Offense
AGG: Aggression. Measures attacking intent. Tracks velocity/power output on break building, and high-risk opening cue selections.
POT: Potting. Baseline shot accuracy. Determines spatial pocket alignment thresholds, recovery limits on tough cuts, and long-range frame execution.
Technical Precision
CTR: Control. Ball manipulation metrics. Governs precision cue-ball spin application, multi-rail escape paths, and micro pace tuning.
SAF: Safety. Defensive containment loops. Measures snooker safety depth, hidden cluster layouts, and tactical containment blocking efficiency.
Mental Mastery
SEL: Selection. Table-mapping vision. Evaluates situational risk analysis, route planning decision loops, and optimal patterns chosen under pressure.
TEM: Temperament. Psychological stamina matrix. Tracks iron composure following critical errors, frame-clearing clutch focus, and high-stakes clearing consistency.
